title: Addition within 10: Joining
standard_text: K.3A model the action of joining to represent addition and the action of separating to represent subtraction; K.3B solve word problems using objects and drawings to find sums up to 10 and differences within 10
meta_desc: Free kindergarten addition worksheets for Texas TEKS K.3A and K.3B: put together, ten frames, number lines, number sentences and stories within 10. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Adding means joining groups together.
  • Count all, or start at the bigger number and count on.
  • Write it as a number sentence: 4 + 3 = 7.

Examples

Example

4 ducks and 3 more ducks

4, 5, 6, 7

Answer: 7 ducks

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting a group twiceTouch each thing once.
Counting only one groupJoin both groups.
Being off by 1Start counting on at the next number.
